relations.sentence: A person is on an account, as its holder or as a member, from the day they join until they leave.

answers.counts: A person counts as a member while they are on at least one account.
answers.whenEnds: The membership stays, with the day it ended.
answers.details: their role on the account: holder or member

relations.sentence: A person also exists in the learning platform, as a learner.

answers.hereFirst: Yes. Then the enrolment there is skipped and recorded, and the next run tries again.

relations.sentence: An account also exists in the mailing system, as a list its people are on.

answers.hereFirst: Yes; the list is made there when the first member is enrolled.

relations.sentence: A person can leave, and is never deleted.

answers.whatStays: Their record and its history stay; their memberships end; their access to the learning platform ends.
answers.whoEnds: one of us, from the admin
